lines.say: Why are you stronger in the evening?
Why does this happen, number twenty.
Your body runs on a daily clock. Strength usually peaks in the late afternoon and evening.
Your body temperature is higher then, so your muscles and nerves work a bit faster.
Studies find people are often a few percent stronger later in the day than in the morning.
But if you always train in the morning, your body adapts, and the gap gets smaller.
So the best time to train is the time you can stick to.
Morning lifters: just warm up a little longer.
